title: A novel mechanism of Reduning injection in sepsis treatment: Targeting inflammatory kinases TBK1 and IKKbeta.
authors: Cao, Liang; Wu, Zi-Yin; Gao, Yan; Geng, Xin-Yi; Yang, Wan-Ting; Yin, Qian-Ru; Liu, Qiu; Wang, Chao; Ji, Chun-Yan; Chen, Ying; Liu, Xin; Wang, Lei; Shao, Jun; Dong, Jia-Yu; Zhang, Chen-Xu; Guo, Zhi-Hong; Wang, Tuan-Jie; Wang, Zhen-Zhong; Zhang, Xin-Zhuang; Wang, Jing-Hui; Xiao, Wei
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药热毒宁注射液通过抑制TBK1/IKKbeta激酶治疗脓毒症，虽含MD模拟蛋白-配体结合，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis-induced systemic inflammation, characterized by immune dysregulation and cytokine storms, presents significant therapeutic challenges. Reduning injection (RDN), a Traditional Chinese Medicine formulation, demonstrates clinical efficacy in sepsis management, yet its molecular mechanisms remain elusive. PURPOSE: This study aimed to unravel RDN's immunomodulatory mechanisms and identify its core effective components targeting key inflammatory signaling networks in sepsis. METHODS: Initially, six complementary in vitro hyperinflammation models (macrophages, endothelial, epithelial, and intestinal barrier cells) were established, with their transcriptomes integrated with patient-derived septic data to prioritize canonical pathways. Transcriptome profiling of RDN, its 14 phytochemicals, and dexamethasone (DEX) was then performed to analyze pathway enrichment and identify key components. In vitro mechanistic validation included enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) for IL-6 inhibition screening; ADP-Glo Kinase Assay for IKKbeta/TBK1 inhibition; Western blot to assess phosphorylation dynamics of tank-binding kinase 1 (TBK1), inhibitor of nuclear factor-kappa B kinase subunit beta (IKKbeta), and nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB); quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) to confirm downregulation of canonical NF-kappaB targets; and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to explore binding mechanisms. For in vivo studies, an LPS-rat sepsis model was used, with preliminary studies defining optimal LPS dose, induction timepoint, and RDN dose. Assessments on septic rats included histopathology (hematoxylin-eosin staining), cytokine profiling (ELISA), complete blood counts, transcriptomic analysis of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) to uncover NF-kappaB pathway modulation, and qRT-PCR validation of transcriptomic changes. RESULTS: The clinically anchored approach effectively prioritized canonical pathways (NF-kappaB, TNF, and cytokine-cytokine receptor interactions) with strong translational relevance. Transcriptome profiling revealed RDN's broad pathway enrichment and identified cynaroside (CYN) as the principal effective component exerting multi-pathway anti-inflammatory effects. Mechanistically, CYN dual-inhibited TBK1 (IC(5)(0): 8.9 muM) and IKKbeta (IC(5)(0): 23.3 muM), suppressing NF-kappaB signaling and cytokine production in macrophages. MD simulations showed stable IKKbeta-CYN and TBK1-CYN complexes, with CYN occupying catalytic pockets via hydrogen bonds with key residues and minimal binding site fluctuations. In LPS-induced septic rats, RDN and CYN mitigated multi-organ injury, reduced systemic inflammation (decreased IL-6 and TNF-alpha), restored complete blood counts, and inhibited NF-kappaB activation. CONCLUSION: This study advances understanding of TCM's multi-target immunomodulation in sepsis via a framework integrating high-dimensional data and experimental validation. CYN's dual-kinase inhibition highlights its potential as a precision therapeutic for sepsis and hyperinflammatory disorders, while reinforcing TCM's value in novel immunomodulatory drug discovery within network pharmacology and systems medicine paradigms.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症诱导的全身性炎症，以免疫失调和细胞因子风暴为特征，构成重大治疗挑战。热毒宁注射液（RDN），一种中药制剂，在脓毒症管理中显示出临床疗效，但其分子机制仍不明确。目的：本研究旨在揭示RDN的免疫调节机制，并识别其靶向脓毒症关键炎症信号网络的核心有效成分。方法：首先，建立了六种互补的体外过度炎症模型（巨噬细胞、内皮细胞、上皮细胞和肠道屏障细胞），并将其转录组与患者来源的脓毒症数据整合，以优先排序经典通路。随后对RDN、其14种植物化学物和地塞米松（DEX）进行转录组分析，以解析通路富集并识别关键成分。体外机制验证包括：酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）用于IL-6抑制筛选；ADP-Glo激酶试验用于IKKbeta/TBK1抑制；Western blot评估TANK结合激酶1（TBK1）、核因子kappa-B激酶亚基beta抑制剂（IKKbeta）和核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）的磷酸化动态；定量实时聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）确认经典NF-kappaB靶标的下调；以及分子动力学（MD）模拟探索结合机制。体内研究中，使用LPS诱导的大鼠脓毒症模型，初步研究确定最佳LPS剂量、诱导时间点和RDN剂量。对脓毒症大鼠的评估包括：组织病理学（苏木精-伊红染色）、细胞因子谱（ELISA）、全血细胞计数、外周血单核细胞（PBMCs）转录组分析以揭示NF-kappaB通路调节，以及qRT-PCR验证转录组变化。结果：临床锚定方法有效优先排序了经典通路（NF-kappaB、TNF和细胞因子-细胞因子受体相互作用），具有强转化相关性。转录组分析揭示RDN的广泛通路富集，并识别木犀草苷（CYN）为主要有效成分，发挥多通路抗炎作用。机制上，CYN双重抑制TBK1（IC(5)(0)：8.9 μM）和IKKbeta（IC(5)(0)：23.3 μM），抑制巨噬细胞中NF-kappaB信号和细胞因子产生。MD模拟显示IKKbeta-CYN和TBK1-CYN复合物稳定，CYN通过氢键与关键残基占据催化口袋，结合位点波动最小。在LPS诱导的脓毒症大鼠中，RDN和CYN减轻多器官损伤，降低全身炎症（IL-6和TNF-alpha减少），恢复全血细胞计数，并抑制NF-kappaB激活。结论：本研究通过整合高维数据和实验验证的框架，推进了对中药在脓毒症中多靶点免疫调节的理解。CYN的双激酶抑制凸显其作为脓毒症和过度炎症性疾病精准治疗药物的潜力，同时强化了中药在网络药理学和系统医学范式下新型免疫调节药物发现中的价值。
